exact_statement: Let u be a signed sum of disjoint affine physical Y-cell indicators with intrinsic quadratic F2 phases, no complete cover required. Put mu=||u||_2^2, alpha=min nonzero component mass and R=mu/alpha. Then mu H(P_u)<=(log2(R)+1+log2(e)) E(u), and its complete row bill mu log2(1/mu)+mu H(P_u)<=(log2(R)+3+log2(e)) E(u). In particular FOUR equal-mass components have full coefficient5+log2(e)<13/2 independent of codimension or completion. For a Boolean F=sum_t 1_Ct (-1)^qt chi_{L(y)+J_t}(x), where the at most M affine phase cells partition independent uniform Y, have max codimension k, quadratic phases, arbitrary constant offsets J_t and a COMMON affine label map L of arbitrary rank, EVERY physical X/Y restriction satisfies H(S_Y|S_X)<=(k+log2(M)+1+log2(e)) I_Y and full H(F)<=(k+log2(M)+3+log2(e)) I_Y. Eight phase cells give full coefficient13+log2(e)<29/2 independently of carrier rank or number of frequency labels. At L=0 the stronger previous coefficient k+3+log2(e) is retained. Fresh Boolean data tensor factors have F2 degree<=k+2<=M+1; degree9 is sharp for eight cells. Arbitrary spectral correlations and optional integer X-degree bound d>=1 are allowed. Equal masses alone are NOT restriction-stable: actual Boolean row family A={s=0,u=0}, B={s=1,v=0} acquires ratio2^r after u=0.
hypotheses: Uniform independent physical X,Y cubes; bits entropy and original physical influence
Local rows: disjoint affine cells, unit quadratic signs; alpha>0; arbitrary proper union permitted
Stable class: complete affine phase partition of max codim k with <=M nonempty cells, common affine carrier L, constant label offsets
Constants depend on phase complexity or local mass ratio, not dimension, carrier rank or an actually satisfied optional integer X-degree cap

first_unproved_line: Proper FOUR-cell rows of unbounded mass disparity without a bounded-complexity common-carrier source still have an unbounded log2(mu/alpha_min) loss. No absolute rate is proved for them. Equal-mass row payment alone is not hereditary. Full FEI and universal source/erasure/history conversion remain open.
